Why this website is different

Vĩnh Long as a living place, not a checklist.

Most destination websites start with attractions. This one starts with people, routes and local knowledge. The goal is to help international visitors understand who can host an experience, what actually happens, how places connect, and how to request something more personal than a standard package.

Local-firstBuild trips around boat operators, garden households, cooks, artisans and storytellers.
Direct conversationFuture host profiles are designed for enquiry and itinerary discussion before booking.
Flexible by designEvery listing can become a starting point for a custom route, not a rigid package.
Community valueThe model is designed to keep more visitor spending connected to local services and households.
2026 destination context

Vĩnh Long province now spans the former Vĩnh Long, Bến Tre and Trà Vinh areas. This prototype deliberately goes deep first on the Vĩnh Long River Heartland; Coconut Country and Khmer & Coast can be added as connected destination regions in the next phase.

Meet local hosts

Real roles. Local knowledge.

Instead of inventing named guides, this prototype models the host types Vĩnh Long should onboard and verify: boat captains, orchard households, heritage interpreters and local cooks.

Prototype note: host identities shown here are role-based placeholders. Public launch should only show profiles after identity, contact, language and service verification.

Stories from the river

Editorial depth before booking depth.

Stories help international visitors understand context, not only logistics — especially when the portal now spans Mang Thít, Khmer heritage, island community life and ecological forest tourism.

Travel essentials

Useful for an international visitor.

Production should connect these cards to verified live transport, weather, contact and accessibility information.

☀

When to go

November–April is generally drier. May–October is greener and wetter, with seasonal fruit adding another reason to visit.

⌁

How to move

Think in combinations: road transfer + local boat + bicycle or short walks. Route detail should be confirmed with the host.

◉

Photography etiquette

Ask before close-up portraits, respect working boats and homes, and avoid treating everyday livelihoods as staged attractions.

◎

Language & support

Host cards should state real language capability. Translation support can be offered where direct English is limited.

Greater Vĩnh Long · 2026

One province, three travel regions.

The current province joins the former Vĩnh Long, Bến Tre and Trà Vinh spaces. A strong international portal should make that geography understandable without losing each region’s identity.

River Heartland

Vĩnh Long city, An Bình, Trà Ôn, Mang Thít, orchard villages, cù lao cycling routes and the Cổ Chiên river system.

Core live region

Coconut Country

Former Bến Tre area: coconut landscapes, community tourism, craft villages and river-to-coast routes. Nature-led forest tourism can also be positioned here as the platform expands.

Expansion track

Khmer & Coast

Former Trà Vinh area: Khmer culture, Chùa Âng, Cồn Chim community tourism, traditional crafts, green urban tourism and coastal ecosystems.

Pilot additions now included
